11: When an ongoing apocalypse halts the production of Gabby’s new film, she escapes to see her artist friend Tona in La Union, a former booming beach town and strategic site for a US military base. Double billed with YOU ARE THE FILM.
9-temples-to-heaven: Thailand, Singapore, France, Norway, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Qatar
A man takes his sick mother and nine family members on a single-day temple pilgrimage after his boss predicts she may die soon.
a-girl-unknown: A Chinese girl is passed between three families from the age of 6 to 18, receiving each time a new name and identity. As she searches for belonging and the possibility of love, she has to navigate between the weight of her past and the uncertainty of her future, until she finds her own way.
ella-arcangel-awit-ng-pangil-at-kuko: Ella Arcangel: Awit ng Pangil at Kuko

Ella, a young mambabarang from the slums of Metro Manila, must harness her true powers to find her missing best friend and battle both the supernatural and societal injustice. Who are the real monsters?
fruit-gathering: In industrial Yangon, young factory worker San Kyi dreams of returning to her native village. Her relationship with co-worker Theint Theint Oo evolves from closeness to growing distance, revealing tensions between their expectations and life prospects. Amid exhausting labour, social repression, and economic uncertainty, both women seek escape and intimacy.
fujiko: Subjected to harsh treatment by her husband Jiro’s family, Fujiko is devastated when Mari is kidnapped by Jiro’s relatives. With the help of her own mother, Chiyo, Fujiko regains her child. Against the advice and judgment of those around her, she chooses to raise Mari as a single mother.
hearing: Vietnam, Singapore, Norway, France, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Cambodia, Thailand, Taiwan

Ninh lives with his mother and misses his ex-wife Ngoc and their young children. In his work as a mechanic who installs decibel meters in public spaces and homes, Ninh observes the silence that haunts relationships. Wishing for his parents, who live apart and do not speak to each other, to reconcile, his fear of losing connection to his loved ones forces Ninh to face life’s unpredictable rhythms.
the-burning-giants: While an invisible smoke engulfs western Thailand, a displaced couple from the Karen ethnic minority dream of returning home.
the-world-before: Jin has never left the island where she was born, with no road to the mainland, where the sea sets the rhythm of everyday life and everyone is bound to one another. When Dujae, her childhood friend, returns for his grandmother’s funeral and stays on in her empty house, Jin finds small excuses to visit, and little by little, seeing him becomes part of her daily routine. As the summer unfolds, the island she thought she knew starts to feel unfamiliar, its known faces and places quietly shifting into something new. For the first time, Jin sees the island, and herself, differently. But summer, like everything else on the island, will not stay.
angh: In 1960s Nagaland, a proud Konyak chief struggles to protect his dying traditions when an American missionary arrives with promises of aid that threaten his people’s identity. As his wife’s health deteriorates and famine looms, he and his mute son must make an impossible choice between survival and staying true to their ancestral ways.
baby-jackfruit-baby-guava: When an unplanned baby enters the lives of a conservative mother, neurodivergent daughter and detached gay son, the trio travels back in time through their diaries and family photos to mend ruptured bonds and prepare for a new cycle of motherhood.
furies: During Lebanon’s corruption-fueled economic collapse, the banks freeze millions of depositors out of their own life savings. Maro, a determined single mom, and her wild-hearted sister Dalia begin to scheme a daring, all-night heist to get their own money back.
beach-fictions: Cameroon, France, Belgium, Benin, Saudi Arabia, Qatar

Josette (80) lives alone in Yaoundé, Cameroon. All her children have left for the West. She encourages them to build houses in Cameroon, a ploy to bring them back to her. But the unexpected bond she forms with Sarah, a young woman from her neighborhood, shatters everything she has built her life on: her family, her responsibility, and her hopes.
la-gradiva: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.
sad-girlz: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers in their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in her best friend has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the two are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet about it, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.
the-color-of-the-sun: During summer break on Okinawa’s main island, Kamei and his friends face uncertain futures, until they meet Colin, a teenager from the American base in Naha, and everything changes.
we-are-aliens: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.
big-little-things: A seemingly perfect middle-class Chinese family faces an unprecedented situation when Lei brings a man home on NYE to pretend to be her boyfriend. Her same-sex girlfriend’s unexpected visit intertwined her with a real intimacy crisis.
flesh-and-fuel: A lonely French trucker’s routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.
gugu-s-world: Gugu, a black boy living with his grandmother, experiences memories and revelations when the old city where she lived returns.
i-rarely-wake-up-dreaming: The love of Olya and Oleh, a young queer Ukrainian couple, is put to the test when one partner’s gender transition collides with Russia’s full-scale invasion. As war narrows and challenges the boundaries of masculinity and femininity, they struggle to preserve their bond and sense of self. What does it mean to be a man in a country that is fighting for its identity and survival?
jim-queen: When Heterosis - a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.
little-trouble-girls: 16-year-old Lucia joins the Catholic school choir where she befriends senior Ana-Maria. During a choir retreat Lucia’s attraction to a restoration worker creates tension with Ana-Maria and challenges her faith.
lovers-in-the-blue-night: Set against the margins of Mumbai, the film follows four migrants – a gay husband, his wife working in a bar, a thief, and a pimp – whose lives converge around love, survival, and longing.
teenage-sex-and-death-at-camp-miasma: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma

After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.
a-long-winter: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.
everytime: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun, past and present quietly start to overlap.
fatherland: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
fjord: Romania, Norway, France, Finland, Denmark, Sweden, USA

After the deaths of Mihai’s parents, Mihai and Lisbeth Gheorghiu leave everything behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbeth’s family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth offers the promise of a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghius’ young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.
makikiraan-po: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Father Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.
nowhere-to-lay-my-eyes: With her brother, Sang-hee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother’s restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a “grass tomb”. His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sang-hee’s films.
the-beloved: The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his new project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. Living together on set will foster a closeness they haven’t shared for years, but it will also reopen old wounds that never healed.
the-diary-of-a-chambermaid: A young Romanian woman living in France works for a French family and joins a theatre company who are adapting Octave Mirbeau’s The Diary of a Chambermaid.
vintage-violence: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.
a-is-for-agustin: A Is for Agustin + Agos, Ang Batang Isla

DOUBLE BILL: In A IS FOR AGUSTIN, an Indigenous man in his forties enters grade school to learn to read after years of workplace exploitation. Meanwhile, AGOS, ANG BATANG ISLA premieres its debut episode following Agos, a curious, sun-kissed girl always full of grand ideas on a Philippine island. This opening installment features narration by Kuya Kim Atienza. Crafted by all-Filipino creatives, the series unites theater performers and animators through motion-capture technology, and young voice actors. It stands as a love letter to Filipino children which is grounded in family values, safety, and the art of play in an algorithm-driven world. Made possible thanks to the partnership with the Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM) and Amber Studios MNL
club-kid: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.
fucktoys: A cursed young woman sets out on a wild fundraising adventure through Trashtown, USA, after she’s told by multiple psychics that she can break the curse by paying them $1000.
i-grew-an-inch-when-my-father-died: i grew an inch when my father died

When their abusive father is murdered by a neighbour, two brothers must grapple with loss and liberty while navigating their friendship with the killer’s son. A deeply felt debut about the complexities of crime and inherited guilt.
ibuku: A widowed mother races against time and bureaucracy to reach her migrant-worker daughter, who faces execution abroad, and seek clemency for her.
look-back: The overly confident Fujino and the shut-in Kyomoto couldn’t be more different, but a love of drawing manga brings these two small-town girls together.
patay-na-si-hesus: When Iyay, a single mother, learns that her estranged husband has died, she drags the entire family on a road trip from Cebu to Dumaguete to attend the funeral.
the-remotes: On an island where people are controlled as avatars by a mysterious driving-app voice, two estranged sisters join a detective and a rebel motorcyclist to uncover whether the voice belongs to their dead mother.
los-tigres: Industrial-diver siblings Antonio and Estrella face financial ruin until cocaine hidden in a tanker’s hull offers them a dangerous way out.
you-are-the-film: Madoka and Kazuma visit different cinemas to unwind—only to discover that each is watching the other person’s life unfold onscreen in real time. Double billed with 11.
you-can-see-everything: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
amores-perros: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man.
batang-west-side: When a Filipino teen is found fatally shot on the streets of New Jersey, the investigation into his death reveals the struggles of the Filipino-American community, including the horrifying effects of methamphetamine on its youth.
presenting-pete-lacaba-jaguar-free: Poldo, a poor man, takes up a job as a security guard at a high-class apartment complex. However, he soon finds himself protecting his employer’s son from the violent attacks of a nightclub owner.
presenting-pete-lacaba-sister-stella-l-p: Focus on Pete Lacaba: Sister Stella L.

A nun who acts as a counselor in a home for unwed mother undergoes political awakening when her friend and namesake belonging to the same congregation as hers inspires her to get involved in the struggle for justice and freedom of striking workers in a cooking oil company.
perfect-blue: After leaving pop music to become an actress, Mima fears an obsessed fan is stalking her as murders and visions make reality increasingly difficult to distinguish from performance.
possession: A young woman left her family for an unspecified reason. The husband determines to find out the truth and starts following his wife. At first, he suspects that a man is involved. But gradually, he finds out more and more strange behaviors and bizarre incidents that indicate something more than a possessed love affair.
arrested-memory: Lee is a superstar police detective in Taipei. After losing his team during a crime investigation, he is haunted by guilt and transferred to a rural police station. Traumatized by the incident, Lee develops amnesia—but is determined to keep it a secret. Soon, he is assigned a new case: the kidnapping of the son of an influential Japanese businessman. As his memory continues to fade, Lee can only rely on his instincts—which, against all odds, lead him to the criminals.
chronovisor: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.
i-love-paris: After being transformed into a vampire, a Parisian singer pursues stardom at the cost of her soul.
moonglow: In 1970s Manila, a jaded police detective, who, unbeknownst to her colleagues, is the mastermind behind a successful heist, is paired up with her former lover, an obsessively truth-seeking detective, to crack the very crime that she orchestrated.
the-unknown: Photographer David Zimmerman rarely leaves home until friends bring him to a wild party. He becomes fixated on a mysterious woman and follows her. By dawn, his life transforms - he awakens in her body.
bomba-bernal: “This is not a film by Khavn”. Bomba Bernal is the hardcore pornographic bomb handjobbed in the hidden love-hotels of Philippine cinematographic history detonated by the satirical deep throat of one of the greatest 20th century Filipino filmmakers, Ishmael Bernal (1938-1996).
i-deserve-a-lover-whose-every-rise-sets-: I Deserve a Lover Whose Every Rise Sets Fiery Dooms Raging Across the Skies

Set between Tabriz and Tehran in the weeks between the Twelve-Day War and the subsequent conflict between Iran, Israel, and the United States, this film follows two Iranian artists whose lives have become inseparable from a vast private archive assembled over decades: photographs, documents, discarded objects, and traces of anonymous lives. Working somewhere between collecting, hoarding, preservation, and obsession, they have created an improvised museum of neglected lives, one in which sex workers, young soldiers, child labourers, gay lovers, and ordinary families emerge through abandoned albums, damaged belongings, and fragments of memory left behind by history.
the-illusion-of-an-everlasting-summer: The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer
Over 25 years, filmmaker Alessandra Sanguinetti follows cousins Guillermina and Belinda from childhood games on the Argentine Pampas into work, motherhood, and diverging adult lives.
to-the-moon-and-back: Despite their different aspirations, backgrounds, and origins, Ilyasse and Pauline, scientists in their early twenties, share one common dream: escaping to the moon to address Earth’s problems. Each of them dedicates all their resources and efforts to achieve this goal. But what if space was political, and what if dreaming was too?
union-town: Set against the backdrop of New York City, the film follows delivery industry workers as they take on some of the world s most powerful corporate giants, touching on the challenges, joys and human elements that make this movement possible.
qcshorts-grantees-world-premiere: Carla Pulido Ocampo, Clister Santos, Maki Makilan, Rodiell Veloso, Toni Cañete
program-1-rotten-work: QCShorts Program 1: At Night We Lead Different Lives
Apa Agbayani, Carlo Francisco Manatad, Ivan Tan, Maki Makilan, Lê Hoàng
Philippines, USA, Singapore, Vietnam, France, Indonesia

Featuring sensual titles from the Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam, France, and Indonesia, this program of shorts venture into the double lives humans live after dark. Moving between magic realism, horror, fantasy, and national allegory, together they examine the traps of transactional relationships and the ways they eventually lead to self-implosion. 

The lineup includes AND IF THUY DIDN'T EXIST (dir. Carlo Francisco Manatad), BODY WORKS (dir. Maki Makilan), IS THIS DESIRE? (dir. Apa Agbayani), SHE SAID (dir. Ivan Tan), and THROUGH THE CRACKS (dir. Lê Hoàng)
program-2-little-blasphemies: QCShorts Program 2: A Little Blasphemy Never Hurt Anyone
Ananth Subramaniam, Jen Nee Lim, Ratchapoom Boonbunchachoke, Rodiell Veloso, and Thiên Ân Nguyên
Malaysia, Philippines, France, Japan, Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, South Korea

Featuring the most irreverent Southeast Asian shorts in this year's slate, this program from Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, and Singapore follows humans reckoning with faith and desires after their bizarre interactions with animals and beasts. The lineup includes BLEAT! (dir. Ananth Subramaniam), FRUIT (dir. Jen Nee Lim), RUN SHIRLEY RUN! (dir. Rodiell Veloso), THE BOVINE COMEDY (dir. Ratchapoom Boonbunchachoke), and THE DREAM IS A SNAIL (dir. Thiên Ân Nguyên)
program-3-all-our-mothers-were-once-girl: QCShorts Program 3: All Mothers Were Once Girls
Clister Santos, Kylechandler Bigay, Natalie Sin, Toni Cañete

Featuring women of all ages from the Philippines and Singapore, this program of shorts peel back the unlived lives of four mothers through the eyes of the children around them. Filled with unparalleled tenderness, this program promises great laughs and many tears. Includes THE 4PLY CLANDESTINE SYSTEM (dir. Natalie Sin), GANDANG LOLA (dir. Kylechandler Bigay), MAANAA KANIMO (dir. Toni Cañete), and SANA'Y NANDITO KA (dir. Clister Santos)
program-4-the-mountains-always-ask-for-m: QCShorts Program 4: The Mountains Always Ask for More
Arief Budiman, Carla Pulido Ocampo, Jaime Morados, Savunthara Seng, Timoteus Anggawan Kusno

Featuring deeply political and more experimental films from the Philippines, Indonesia, and Cambodia, this program of Southeast Asian titles use filmmaking to cut through our assumptions of the mountain—revealing in its wake the truths, histories, and scars that nature has concealed through time. Includes A GHOST CAN ONLY HOWL (dir. Carla Pulido Ocampo), GOLDEN ISLAND (dir. Arief Budiman), INCIDENT ON THE MOUNTAIN (dir. Savunthara Seng), OBSCURA (dir. Timoteus Anggawan Kusno), and THEY MADE MONSTERS (dir. Jaime Morados).

magic-kingdom-the-legend-of-damortis: Magic Kingdom: Ang Alamat ng Damortis

The Kingdom of Damortis was once ruled by the kind-hearted Empress Sofia who was ordered to be killed by Basilicus, her brother who has a great desire for the throne. Princess Dahlia, heir to the throne elopes with the blind singer Mico. Amain and his warrior trainees, Jobert, Samuel, and Oman are tasked to protect the princess and save Damortis from the evil forces of Basilicus.
